dimensions.name: Stakeholder Interests
dimensions.why_relevant: [Sample response – sample mode ignores what you typed.] Three departments each own one of the systems and each trusts its own numbers, so any fix needs their buy-in.
dimensions.key_question: Who loses control or visibility if the numbers are consolidated?

dimensions.name: Speed to Solution
dimensions.why_relevant: Leadership needs reliable figures for the board review, which fixes the timeline.
dimensions.key_question: What is the latest date the board numbers must be trusted?

dimensions.name: Data and Uncertainty
dimensions.why_relevant: No one yet knows how far apart the three systems' figures really are.
dimensions.key_question: How large are the discrepancies, and which system is closest to right?

dimensions.name: Implementation Feasibility
dimensions.why_relevant: The client's IT team is small and already stretched.
dimensions.key_question: Who on the client side can actually do the integration work?

dimensions.name: Short-Term vs. Long-Term Impact
dimensions.why_relevant: A quick fix for the board could make the long-term data platform harder to build.
dimensions.key_question: Is the board deadline worth a solution that may be thrown away later?
